issue.title: gcal: dedupe the same event across synced calendars by iCalUID
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Proposed by bob-cli-lr.5 (note #1), the enable-birthdays phase of epic bob-cli-lr
(plan:202611/gcal_calendar_marks.md). Filed by the bob-cli-lr land agent.

When `gcal.calendars` lists several calendars, the same Google event can show up on more
than one of them (an invite copied to a shared calendar, or a group calendar Bryan also
attends). Bob keys journal identity on `calendar_id + \u{1f} + event_id`, so each copy
becomes its own row: two bullets for one meeting, each with its own MEET filing, ack, and
time accounting. `docs/gcal.md` § Known limits now says "Cross-calendar duplicates are
not merged."

Research and implement cross-calendar deduplication keyed by iCalUID plus instance start:
which copy owns the row (config order? primary first?), what the other copies do
(omitted with a reason in `bob gcal list -a`), how the journal carries both identities so
removing one calendar does not orphan the row, and how marks render for a merged row.

## Why out of scope

bob-cli-lr deliberately listed "deduplicating across calendars by title or iCalUID" as a
v1 non-goal. The only calendar it enabled (Birthdays) never overlaps the primary
calendar, so no duplicates occur today.

## Evidence

- `src/native/gcal/snapshot.rs::resolve_synced_calendars` and `FetchContext::fetch_days`
  fetch each configured calendar independently.
- `tests/gcal_sync.rs` pins that the same event id on two calendars gives two rows with
  independent journal state (added by bob-cli-lr.1).

task_type_fields.proposal: Merge copies of one Google event (same iCalUID and instance start) that appear on more than one configured calendar into one Event row with a deterministic owning calendar.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-lr made cross-calendar dedupe a v1 non-goal; its only new calendar (Birthdays) never overlaps primary.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-lr.5 proposed it as a planned follow-up; multi-calendar sync now makes cross-calendar duplicate rows possible, and Known limits says they are not merged.

payload.description: Contacts birthdays can repeat people already on the hand-kept Birthdays calendar; cross-calendar dedupe rules should cover both
